notes.title: Progress Blog #16: Ghost AI – Optimization and Testing Phase
notes.content:
Hello Ghost Hunters,

Over the past week, we’ve been working intensively on the Ghost AI, addressing some well-known issues that arose during our testing phases. One of the biggest challenges was that the Ghost AI struggled to detect obstacles and navigate stairs – a critical aspect for the planned levels where such movements are essential.

[h2]What Have We Improved?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Obstacle Detection:[/b] The ghost can now interact with obstacles more efficiently, preventing it from getting stuck on objects.
[*] [b]Stair Navigation:[/b] A frequent issue was the AI’s inability to properly navigate stairs. This has been resolved, which is vital for the dynamic level designs we aim to achieve.
[/list]

These improvements have already been tested on our test map in various scenarios, and we are confident that the Ghost AI now operates reliably. We’ve tested it across multiple platforms and under different conditions to ensure it performs well in all situations.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
The Ghost AI is currently undergoing internal testing and will be further refined alongside numerous other features set to launch in Version 0.9.0. While we’re very pleased with the results so far, some final tests are still required before we can make the new features accessible to everyone.

Our internal tests have been very promising so far, and we are confident that the changes will be available to you soon. However, there are still a few final steps we need to complete to ensure everything works as intended. Once we’re confident that the new features are stable and the performance has improved, we’ll be sure to let you know.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
The development of the Ghost AI continues to make good progress, and we are confident that this feature will soon become an integral part of the game. We’ll keep you updated and inform you as soon as we’re ready to release the update.

Thank you for your patience and support!

Your Development Team

notes.content:

We’re excited to share the latest developments with you. This past weekend, we tackled several major issues and achieved noticeable improvements:

The performance issues caused by our tree assets, particularly on Windows and PlayStation 5, have been significantly reduced. There’s still room for optimization, but the game is running much smoother now.

The day-night cycle has been thoroughly reworked and is now functioning perfectly again. Additionally, we’ve adjusted the scene contrast, making the lighting—especially at night—more realistic and atmospheric.

[h2]Why the Open Alpha Branch?[/h2]
The new update in the Open Alpha Branch will differ significantly from the current version of the game. It’s worth giving this branch a try. Once this version is stable, we’ll transfer it to the standard branch.

[h2]Our Mini Roadmap[/h2]
[list]

[*] Phase 2: After successful testing and stabilization, the update will be transferred to the standard branch.

notes.title: Dev Blog 17: New Ghost Types Revealed
notes.content:
Welcome to another thrilling glimpse into the world of our Ghostbusters saga! In this latest version of our game, we've delved deep into the shadows to bring you the most sinister and fascinating ghost species you've ever seen. Each of these new ghost species brings unique challenges, dark secrets, and surprising twists that will take your gaming experience to the next level.

Prepare to put your skills to the test, as these ghosts are not only numerous, but also extraordinarily complex in their appearances and behaviors. From the disturbing terrors of an avenging Revenant to the stormy powers of the Skystormer, the new range of ghosts will captivate you and challenge you in all new ways.

Dive into the details and learn more about the spooky evidence items, the right means of scaring them away, and the mysterious activity patterns these ghosts have to offer. Get ready for a thrill ride of the highest order and equip yourself with everything you need to fight the darkness!

[h2]The full list of ghosts:[/h2]
[h3]1. The Revenant[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A vengeful ghost with the appearance of past injuries, tormented by his violent death. He often appears near accident sites or old hospitals.
[*] [b]Evidence items:[/b] Bloody handprints, torn clothing, wounded footprints.
[*] [b]Repellents:[/b] Holy water.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Houses, cemetery, hospital.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] More aggressive at night.
[/list]
[h3]2. The Poltergeist[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A chaotic spirit that loves to make noise and move objects without warning. Its appearance is often associated with a chaotic atmosphere.
[*] [b]Evidence items:[/b] Moved furniture, broken glassware, scattered piles of paper.
[*] [b]Deterrents:[/b] Incense.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Houses, subway station, kindergarten.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] Neither more aggressive or active during the day nor at night.
[/list]
[h3]3. The Shadow Spirit[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A dark, formless spirit that hides in the shadows and often appears in dark corners or near places with little light.
[*] [b]Evidence:[/b] Shadowy silhouettes, shadowy noises, darkened areas.
[*] [b]Repellents:[/b] Bright light sources.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Houses, cemetery, hotel.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] More aggressive at night.
[/list]
[h3]4. The Siren[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A ghostly woman with a beguiling voice whose voice can hypnotize or mislead victims.
[*] [b]Evidence:[/b] Scattered seashells, eerie singing, wet footprints.
[*] [b]Repellents:[/b] White noise machines.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Lighthouse, cemetery, ruins.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] More aggressive during the day.
[/list]
[b]5. The Lost Child Ghost[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] An innocent ghost of a child who is desperately searching for its parents and often appears near children's toys or children's drawings.
[*] [b]Evidence items:[/b] Children's drawings, toys, small, broken pieces of furniture.
[*] [b]Deterrents:[/b] Music boxes.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Houses, kindergarten, hospital.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] Neither more aggressive nor active during the day or at night.
[/list]
[h3]6. The Shapeshifter[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A ghost who can change his appearance to deceive his pursuers. He can transform into different shapes to conceal his true identity.
[*] [b]Evidence items:[/b] Altered portraits, distorted reflections, strange notes or messages.
[*] [b]Chasing away:[/b] Truth mirrors.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Houses, company premises, hotel.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] Neither more aggressive nor active during the day nor at night.
[/list]
[h3]7. The Soul Catcher[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A powerful spirit that can capture the souls of the living to keep them trapped in the spirit world.
[*] [b]Evidence items:[/b] Flickering candles, unusual light reflections, ghostly outlines in mirrors.
[*] [b]Chasing away:[/b] Protective amulets.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Cemetery, ruins, hospital.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] More aggressive at night.
[/list]
[h3]8. The Hellhound[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A demonic spirit in the form of a large dog, whose presence is often associated with chaos and destruction.
[*] [b]Evidence:[/b] Burn marks, broken chains, dog prints in the dust.
[*] [b]Repellents:[/b] Fire sage.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Company premises, ruins, subway station.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] Neither more aggressive nor active during the day nor at night.
[/list]
[h3]9. The White Lady[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] An elegant but unhappy ghost of a deceased woman who often appears near old family estates or ruins.
[*] [b]Evidence Items:[/b] White scraps of cloth, wailing noises, fading footprints.
[*] [b]Repellents:[/b] Rose water.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Cemetery, ruins, hotel.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] More aggressive at night.
[/list]
[h3]10. The Madman[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A ghost tormented by a state of perpetual madness. It often causes chaos and destruction, leaving its victims in a state of confusion.
[*] [b]Evidence:[/b] Broken objects, jumbled notes, chaotic scratch marks.
[*] [b]Repellents:[/b] Calming potions.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Houses, hospital, subway station.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] More aggressive at night.
[/list]
[h3]11. The Ice Spirit[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A cold, frozen spirit whose presence can greatly reduce temperatures. It often leaves behind frozen surfaces and ice crystals.
[*] [b]Evidence:[/b] Frozen surfaces, ice crystals, cold, damp spots.
[*] [b]Repellents:[/b] Heat lamps.

[/list]

[*] [b]Repellents:[/b] Blessing prayers.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Company premises, ruins, subway station.

[*] [b]Evidence items:[/b] Sleep tracks or sleeping bags, nightmarish visions on notes, eerie noises while sleeping.
[*] [b]Repellents:[/b] Dreamcatchers.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Houses, hotel, hospital.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] More aggressive at night.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A mystical spirit from Nordic folklore, known for her enchanting appearance and ability to mislead people.
[*] [b]Evidence items:[/b] Hidden footprints, golden cords, eerie songs.
[*] [b]Deterrents:[/b] Silver items.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Forests, ruins, old caves.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] Neither more aggressive nor active during the day nor at night.
[/list]
[h3]16. The Nightmare[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A dark spirit that haunts people's dreams and sends them into horrific visions to spread fear.
[*] [b]Evidence items:[/b] Distorted dream images, unexplained noises in the night, fearful screams.
[*] [b]Repellents:[/b] Calming herbs.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Houses, hotels, hospitals.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] More aggressive at night.

[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A spirit that is bound to a specific location due to a curse and constantly haunts the location to ease its torment.
[*] [b]Evidence items:[/b] Ancient curse writings, decayed personal items, mysterious writings on walls.
[*] [b]Chasing devices[/b]: Uncursing rituals.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Ruins, old family estates, graveyards.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] Neither more aggressive or active during the day nor at night.
[/list]
[h3]18. The Soul Trader[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A sinister spirit who trades souls for material goods and often appears near markets or trading places.
[*] [b]Evidence items:[/b] Strange trade records, glowing symbols, eerie contracts.
[*] [b]Chasing devices:[/b] Protection rituals.
[*] [b]Level:[/b] Markets, ruins, old trade routes.
[*] [b]Activity:[/b] Neither more aggressive or active during the day nor at night.

Exciting and challenging experiences await you with these new ghosts. Prepare yourself well and immerse yourself in the dark and fascinating world of ghosts. Good luck with your ghost hunt!

Best regards,

notes.title: Dev-Blog #16: New properties of the mind for even more intense experiences
notes.content:
Hello dear Ghost Hunter community,

We are happy to present you exciting news about the properties of the ghosts in our latest dev blog. These new features will make the gaming experience even more exciting and challenging.
[h3]New properties of the ghost:[/h3]
Our latest updates significantly expand the behavior of the ghosts and offer you deeper and more realistic interactions with these supernatural beings. Here are the most important new features:
[h3]1. Confusing abilities:[/h3]
The ghosts now have the ability to actively influence the players' environment and deliberately confuse them. These confusing mechanisms can disrupt the players' orientation, limit their vision or misdirect sounds. Such effects will present players with new challenges and require even better teamwork and strategy.
[h3]2. Influence on the ghost state:[/h3]
A new aspect is the direct influence of the ghost on the players' ghost state. The ghost can either specifically choose a player from the group to hunt, or in COOP mode, target the player with the lowest ghost state. This means that teams must now think strategically about how to manage their ghost state in the game to avoid becoming the ghost's main target.
[h3]3. Different perception abilities:[/h3]
Ghosts vary greatly in their perception abilities, which depend on the type of ghost and the environment:
[list]
[*] [b]Sensitive ghosts:[/b] Some ghosts can hear or see even the slightest movement, meaning players must be very careful not to be detected.
[*] [b]Normal ghosts:[/b] Other ghosts have average perception, allowing them to notice movements and sounds to the usual extent.
[*] [b]Weak ghosts:[/b] There are also ghosts whose perception is severely limited. These ghosts have very poor hearing or vision and present a different kind of challenge.
[/list]
The different perception abilities depend on various factors such as the environment, noise levels and the specific type of ghost. This makes for a varied and dynamic gaming experience where every encounter is unique.
[h3]Growth opportunities and challenges:[/h3]
These new features will fundamentally change the way you approach the game. You will have to adapt your tactics and think strategically to accommodate the different ghosts and their new abilities. Interacting with the ghosts will become more complex and require a high level of attention and coordination within the team.

We are excited about these developments and look forward to telling you more about the impact of these new features on gameplay soon. Stay tuned for further updates and detailed insights into the ongoing development of our game.

Best regards,
The Ghost - Task of the Ghost Hunters development team

notes.title: Dev Blog #15: New graphics options for an individual gaming experience
notes.content:
Hello dear Ghost Hunter community,

Before we dive into the details of the new graphics options, we would like to point out something important: Some of the new settings could be spoilers, as they include special adjustments for certain levels and game sections. We recommend using these options carefully in order to give you the best possible gaming experience without knowing too much about the game world in advance.

[h2]New options under the graphics:[/h2]

From now on, you have a variety of new settings available under the graphics options that allow you to configure the game according to your ideas and optimize your gaming experience. The new options are divided into two main categories: [b]Basic settings[/b] and [b]Advanced settings[/b].

[h2]Basic Settings:[/h2]

In this category you will find options that are easy to adjust and affect basic image quality and appearance:
[list]
[*] [b]Screen Resolution:[/b] Choose the resolution that best suits your monitor and preferences.
[*] [b]Window Mode:[/b] Decide whether you want to play in full screen or windowed mode.
[*] [b]Graphics Quality:[/b] Adjust the overall graphics quality to find a balance between performance and visual detail.
[*] [b]Anti-Aliasing:[/b] Reduces edge artifacts to ensure smoother image display.
[*] [b]Texture Quality:[/b] Determines the level of detail of the textures in the game.
[*] [b]Shadow Quality:[/b] Choose the precision and detail of the shadows.
[*] [b]Reflection Quality:[/b] Optimizes the appearance of reflections.
[*] [b]Post-Processing Quality:[/b] Affects effects such as color correction and blur.
[*] [b]Motion Blur:[/b] Enables or disables motion blur for a more realistic representation of fast movements.
[*] [b]Bloom:[/b] Controls the intensity of lighting effects that create a luminous glow.
[*] [b]Shadow Side:[/b] Adjusts the depth and detail of the shadow sides.
[*] [b]Vignette:[/b] Adds a darker edge environment to draw focus to the center of the image.
[*] [b]Ambient Occlusion:[/b] Improves the light dynamics and shadows in the corners and near objects.
[/list]
[h2]Advanced Settings:[/h2]

For experienced players who want to make even more detailed adjustments, we offer the following advanced options:
[list]
[*] Lighting:
[list]

notes.title: Dev Blog #14: Realistic Equipment Management
notes.content:
Hello dear Ghost Hunter community, in our latest dev blog we would like to give you exciting insights into the development of our second equipment management system. Our goal is to further increase the realism in the game and offer you an even more intense gaming experience.

[h2]Realistic Equipment Management:[/h2] Realism is the focus of this system. In the main menu you will find a display case or cabinet in which all of your purchased equipment is clearly presented. Smaller items are stored in a separate box. The visual experience of this display case or cabinet will give you the feeling of actually standing in your own, well-organized headquarters, ready for the next mission.

[h2]Challenges and details:[/h2] The challenge with this system is that some larger items require an additional item in order to be able to use new ones. This means that you have to plan strategically which pieces of equipment you take with you for your next mission. If you happen to take the wrong item, you won't be able to use the devices. This additional level of planning and preparation brings a new level of depth and excitement to the game. You'll need to carefully prepare your missions and make sure you have the right tools for the job.

[h2]Revised file management system:[/h2] In parallel, we're working on a completely redesigned file management system. This new system is designed to handle our game's complex data much better and more efficiently. In the past, we encountered challenges when processing large amounts of data and complex game mechanics. With the new file management system, we can not only solve these problems, but also lay the foundation for future expansions and features.

Our redesigned file management system will be able to process data faster while increasing the game's stability. It will allow us to integrate detailed game worlds, more complex interactions, and more dynamic game mechanics. What this means for you as a player is that you can enjoy a smoother and more responsive gaming experience even as the game continues to grow and evolve.

[h2]Current Development Status:[/h2] Our development team is working hard to implement and optimize both systems. The goal is to make the gaming experience as immersive and realistic as possible while strengthening the technical foundation of the game. We are confident that these new features and improvements will take your gaming experience to the next level.

Stay tuned for further updates and detailed insights into the development of these exciting new features. We will let you know soon when the first playable update version will be released so you can get your hands on it and try out the new features for yourself.

We would like to thank all buyers for their patience and support during this testing phase. We know it has been a long wait, but we are confident that it has been worth it. With these new features and improvements, we are well on our way to providing you with an outstanding gaming experience.

With great anticipation, The Ghost – Task of the Ghost Hunters development team

Players can now track time in-game and potentially experience seasonal events or special holidays.

This integration also provides a solid foundation for future updates and expansions to the game focused on time-based content.

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]

With these new features, we have taken "The Ghost - Task of the Ghost Hunters" to a new level and further improved the player experience. The expanded day-night cycle, the animated ghost figure in the tutorial and the integration of date, month and year bring additional depth to the game world and offer players even more opportunities for immersion and interaction.
